run.progress reports phases; run.statusComment needs forge access; run.steer needs steering support; run.recover needs recovery support. Cron cannot set statusComment or recover to true.

4. Set by hand

The console never sets the job cap, allowed models, MCP servers, session, image, secrets, waits or replicas; new adds opt out of project secret bundles (run.secretBundle: false). Change the bundle opt-out and these other fields by hand in the triggers file.

Or paste the add tool's fields as JSON

The five kinds

Cron runs a task in a local repository on a schedule. Label starts on an issue label, never a pull request. Comment matches a phrase, with one per forge. Pull request matches forge actions and reviews. Issue matches closing; a one-shot also names its number.

Pull request words per forge

github
labeled, opened, synchronize, reopened, review_submitted, closed
gitlab
open, update, reopen, approved, close
forgejo
label_updated, opened, synchronized, reopened, closed
azure
created, updated
